== Biography ==
Jane Allan was born Feb 1837, christened 26 Feb 1837 in New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]]. <ref>
'''Child Baptism''':

As Jane does not appear with her family in the 1841 Census it is assumed that she passed away before then.
